scope: Candidate APK shipped static declarations plus passive original-client runtime observations.

connectionContexts.basis: User reported the wrong account and requested reopening; do not compare its state with the intended account.
After explicit reopen, user confirmed the correct account reached hall and idled 20 seconds.

definitions.staticDeclared: Recovered shipped declaration, not runtime acceptance.
definitions.decoded: At least one immediate payload decoded; TCP C2S business commands additionally need a matching decoded response.
definitions.actionVerified: Decoded interface linked to a documented user operation; login HTTP links apply to the whole login workflow.
definitions.allObservedPayloadsDecoded: All observed immediate payloads decoded (HTTP counts response bodies only).
definitions.staticUnknowns: Unknowns as of static extraction; retained separately from current runtime status.

gaps.reason: User reported not unlocked or not found.
Single upgrade and breakthrough observed; other variants/systems not yet isolated in current new-account tutorial.
Let features unlock gradually; no purchase or costly repetition requested.
One specified-recruitment completion captured. Other pools, paid/ten-draw/pity/exchange paths and failure cases remain unverified; no exhaustive clicking requested.
Await naturally unlocked functions and individual user actions.

actions.label: User logged into original game and confirmed hall plus 20 seconds idle
stateChanges: User reached hall; login ETF return code is 1.
limitations: HTTP calls are linked to the overall login workflow, not independently isolated button actions.

actions.label: First tutorial battle observed; screenshot shows 1-1 victory settlement
stateChanges: Victory settlement screen observed; item names are not inferred from displayed quantities.
limitations: Capture already contained the start, but an isolated manual start marker was not set.

actions.label: User clicked first settlement confirmation and waited 10 seconds
limitations: No additional game business command between the first victory checkpoint and confirmation-complete checkpoint; exact click time was not recorded. Settlement requests already occurred before the screenshot. This does not establish a separate claim-reward endpoint.

actions.label: User opened team page without confirming a lineup edit
limitations: No isolated team-load command identified. Earlier initialization lineup edits must not be attributed to this page open.

actions.label: User selected a third member, clicked Complete Selection, and waited 10 seconds
stateChanges: Preset changed from two occupied fighter entries to three; the original two identities and positions were retained, one member was added, and all three submitted entries match the response.
limitations: Only pre-lineup type209 is attributed to this completion; type208 was previously automatic initialization traffic.

actions.label: User completed one guided breakthrough and explicitly reported the final click
stateChanges: Same hero identity as login baseline; breakthrough_level increased by exactly one and matches new_break_lv. Other hero fields were retained. Two resource change records have negative deltas; resource names/cost rules are not inferred.
limitations: The earlier user-complete report preceded the actual request. Actual final click was separately reported and measured in packets2407-2411. Resource costs and nested state bytes need separate checks.

actions.label: User clicked Upgrade once after the before marker and waited 10 seconds
stateChanges: One user click requested and returned a multilevel upgrade for the same hero and cell as breakthrough. Level increase matches up_lv_count; breakthrough stage and other normalized hero fields were retained. One resource deduction was reported.
limitations: One-click upgrade-all variant was not performed; no extra repeated upgrades requested.

actions.label: User entered battle after ready marker, then confirmed victory screen with 10 seconds idle before confirmation
stateChanges: Second battle request used three saved hero-position entries; the report has one attacker brief-lineup team with three entries. User confirmed victory.
Settlement response matches the settlement object supplied by the start response; nested settlement bytes and rewards are still unresolved.
limitations: Opaque nested protobuf bytes and replay mechanics are not accepted merely because the outer payload decoded.

actions.label: User logged into the intended account after reopening and confirmed hall plus 20 seconds idle
stateChanges: Intended-account login returned code 1 in an ETF four-tuple; user confirmed hall.
limitations: Earlier tcp-29 is the account corrected by the user. HTTP workflow calls are not independently action-attributed in this recording. Initialization commands are automatic observations.

actions.label: User chose one entry on the specified recruitment page, clicked Complete Selection once and waited 10 seconds
stateChanges: The measured completion invoked draw_hero type601/seq69, not a separately observed selection-save endpoint. Response contains recruit_info with draw_lib matching the request and two resource changes: one negative and one positive. The after screenshot shows a character reveal.
limitations: One user completion does not establish single-draw enum/count semantics. Omitted PB fields are not evidence of absent default values. Selected-character mapping, resource identities/extra bytes, balance reconciliation, pity rules and persistence remain unverified. Follow-on statistic/task pushes are not independently action-verified.
